authority: maintainer-preregistered research prioritization; priority is strategic, not a theorem claim
objective: Maximize independently reviewable mathematical progress and reusable research artifacts, with special weight on work closest to the unresolved unforced A/B frontier and on verifying the 2026 C/D dependency.

priority_semantics.P3: supporting work; never presented as equivalent to theorem progress

nodes.title: Forced → unforced: bridges and obstruction theorems
nodes.strategic_value: Closest current program to the unresolved A/B branch. A rigorous no-go theorem is progress; a valid bridge would be transformative.
nodes.key_question: Can any restart, gluing, limiting, localization, or self-sustaining mechanism eliminate the external force while satisfying the exact A/B target?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Senior 3D Navier–Stokes review before any route is promoted.

nodes.publication_path: Research note/preprint for a new bridge, obstruction theorem, or route-kill result.
nodes.success_changes: Canonical A/B route ledger; new theorem/obstruction; new bounded descendants.

nodes.title: Independent analytic proof audit
nodes.strategic_value: The 2026 construction is the common dependency for most post-result research. Understanding/correctness failures propagate downstream.
nodes.key_question: Which major implications in the analytic proof survive independent PDE scrutiny, with exact hypotheses and source locations?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Independent PDE experts own semantic acceptance.

nodes.publication_path: Public referee-style report, errata, or independent verification note.
nodes.success_changes: Claim/evidence states for C/D and dependency graph.

nodes.title: Lean certificate ↔ Clay statement semantic audit
nodes.strategic_value: Kernel correctness and theorem-target correctness are distinct. This is the machine/human bridge the project must get exactly right.
nodes.key_question: What do the terminal Lean declarations establish under which axioms/dependencies, and how exactly do they map to Fefferman C/D?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Lean + PDE semantic reviewer required for claim elevation.

nodes.publication_path: Reproducibility/semantic correspondence report; reusable formal artifacts.
nodes.success_changes: Formal evidence status and reusable theorem graph.

nodes.title: How restrictive can the force be?
nodes.strategic_value: Measures mathematical distance between the C/D construction and more natural/restricted forcing regimes without falsely calling it A/B progress.
nodes.key_question: Which exact restrictions on the smooth force remain compatible with blowup: divergence-free, small critical norms, prescribed classes, temporal localization, Gevrey constraints?

agent_suitability.human_veto: PDE scope review before promoting feasibility claims.

nodes.success_changes: Constraint lattice and theorems narrowing forced blowup.

nodes.title: Stability, genericity, and abundance , typed correctly
nodes.strategic_value: Separates varying-force density, fixed-force dynamical stability, data stability, parameter robustness, and numerical robustness. Two Sep-9 papers already resolve part of the varying-force question.
nodes.key_question: What remains stable or generic after conditioning on exactly what is held fixed?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Do not infer fixed-force instability from varying-force density.

nodes.publication_path: PDE/dynamical-systems theorem, counterexample, or sharply scoped negative result.
nodes.success_changes: Typed stability map rather than one ambiguous “robustness” claim.

nodes.title: Norm spectrum and criticality
nodes.strategic_value: Connects the explicit concentration scales to the regularity-criterion landscape and to newly reported force-space density thresholds.
nodes.key_question: Which spatial and mixed norms admit rigorous asymptotics or thresholds, and which profile assumptions are actually available?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Heuristic scale counting cannot be promoted to theorem.

nodes.publication_path: Analysis note/paper with rigorous bounds or exact obstruction statement.
nodes.success_changes: Criticality map linked to established hypotheses.

nodes.title: Conceptual skeleton and proof compression
nodes.strategic_value: Makes the construction cognitively reusable by mathematicians and provides natural theorem boundaries for formal/agent work.
nodes.key_question: What is the smallest faithful dependency graph preserving indispensable obligations across paper and Lean?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Compression must not erase dependencies or semantic caveats.

nodes.success_changes: High-quality proof graph and agent-ready theorem decomposition.

nodes.title: Singular manufactured-solution benchmark
nodes.strategic_value: Could turn the construction into a serious solver-verification stress test, but only if enough fields are extractable faithfully.
nodes.key_question: Can a solver-independent benchmark be specified, independently implemented, and used for controlled refinement studies near collapsing scales?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Numerical evidence never upgrades an analytic theorem claim.

nodes.success_changes: Validated benchmark state after independent implementation.

nodes.title: Inverse design and control formulation
nodes.strategic_value: Reframes the forced construction as trajectory design, potentially exposing cost/controllability/constraint structure.
nodes.key_question: What exact state/control spaces and costs capture the construction, and what reachability/obstruction questions are genuinely open?

agent_suitability.human_veto: No reachability/optimality claim without theorem-level evidence.

nodes.success_changes: Typed control problem and bounded theorem targets.

nodes.title: Rotating/stratified extensions
nodes.strategic_value: Tests portability of the cancellation/concentration ideas to other fluid PDEs; important but less directly connected to A/B.
nodes.key_question: Which additional terms appear in a precisely fixed rotating/Boussinesq model and can any cancellation mechanism survive?

agent_suitability.human_veto: No transfer between PDE models without a proved bridge.

nodes.title: Human–agent research protocol experiments
nodes.strategic_value: Improves how scarce expert review and abundant agent compute are allocated; supports every mathematical lane rather than substituting for it.
nodes.key_question: Which independence/sharing/reproduction patterns improve accepted research progress per unit expert review?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Outcome is accepted progress/review burden, not tokens or model self-ratings.

nodes.title: Research interface and atlas
nodes.strategic_value: Critical support surface, but not itself evidence of mathematical progress.
nodes.key_question: Can the interface expose exact status, frontier, evidence, and work packets without flattening uncertainty?

agent_suitability.human_veto: Support work must never outrank frontier mathematics on expert surfaces.
